verdict.rationale: Logseq exposes its own plugin API surface (logseq.App, logseq.Editor, logseq.DB, logseq.Git, logseq.UI, logseq.Assets, logseq.FileStorage), and its official local HTTP server dispatches those same methods through a bearer-token POST /api endpoint with worked curl examples. That is a real first-party programmatic surface to build against. However, the API reference is described as community-driven documentation, and no packaged, versioned SDKs for external languages are evidenced. Probes also found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, and no versioning policy is published. Missing for 10: officially maintained and versioned SDK packages, official (not community) API reference docs, a machine-readable spec or OpenAPI/llms.txt, and hands-on corroboration of building with the SDK.
